Alibaba Group Holding (BABA) Shareholder Suffolk Capital Management Cut Its Stake as Market Value Rose; Mohawk Industries (MHK) Stock Value Declined While Pcj Investment Counsel LTD Has Upped Position
May 26, 2018 - By Vivian Park
Pcj Investment Counsel Ltd increased its stake in Mohawk Industries Inc. (MHK) by 76.6% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Pcj Investment Counsel Ltd bought 3,830 shares as the company’s stock declined 17.56% with the market. The institutional investor held 8,830 shares of the consumer durables company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.44M, up from 5,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Pcj Investment Counsel Ltd who had been investing in Mohawk Industries Inc. for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $15.92 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.46% or $0.97 during the last trading session, reaching $213.36. About 799,306 shares traded. Mohawk Industries, Inc. (NYSE:MHK) has risen 0.12% since May 26, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 11.43% the S&P500.
Suffolk Capital Management Llc decreased its stake in Alibaba Group Holding (BABA) by 13.93% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Suffolk Capital Management Llc sold 11,601 shares as the company’s stock rose 3.18% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 71,705 shares of the business services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $12.36M, down from 83,306 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Suffolk Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Alibaba Group Holding for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $511.84B market cap company. The stock increased 0.93% or $1.83 during the last trading session, reaching $199.2. About 21.27M shares traded or 20.47% up from the average. Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE:BABA) has risen 68.29% since May 26, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 56.74% the S&P500.
Among 39 analysts covering Alibaba ( NYSE:BABA ), 37 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 1 Hold. Therefore 95% are positive. Alibaba had 179 analyst reports since August 12, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The stock of Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE:BABA) has “Buy” rating given on Thursday, January 21 by Standpoint Research. The stock of Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE:BABA) has “Buy” rating given on Thursday, September 7 by Bank of America. The firm has “Outperform” rating by Bernstein given on Wednesday, January 11. Vetr upgraded it to “Buy” rating and $83.87 target in Thursday, August 13 report. The rating was maintained by Morgan Stanley on Friday, August 12 with “Overweight”. The rating was maintained by Needham with “Buy” on Thursday, September 28. As per Wednesday, October 28, the company rating was maintained by RBC Capital Markets. Oppenheimer maintained it with “Outperform” rating and $85 target in Thursday, September 17 report. The stock of Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE:BABA) has “Hold” rating given on Friday, August 14 by TH Capital. The stock has “Reduce” rating by Standpoint Research on Thursday, April 20.
Suffolk Capital Management Llc, which manages about $1.92B and $770.38M US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 102,091 shares to 220,456 shares, valued at $37.31M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Mgm Resorts International (NYSE:MGM) by 25,040 shares in the quarter, for a total of 418,241 shares, and has risen its stake in Rexnord Corp. (NYSE:RXN).
